svg.text: “Las Olas is too expensive to consider.”
It's also the only neighborhood that hasn't corrected.

33301 mid-tier sits at $871,423, down just -2.5% YoY versus Broward at -5.1%. The only ZIP in the footprint with a 3-month uptrend on ZHVI. Premium waterfront is holding its value while everything else moves. If you have the budget, this is what 'flight to quality' looks like in real time — and the value isn't in the discount, it's in not buying something that drops further.
